name: Nairobi Galleria to Ongata Rongai
description: Highland urban start leaving Nairobi Galleria Mall / Bomas, descending through Ongata Rongai commuter corridor onto volcanic phonolite plateau.

name: Ongata Rongai to Kiserian Town
description: Transit corridor crossing Mbagathi / Kandisi seasonal drainage basins, climbing along the southern foot of the Ngong Hills towards Kiserian junction.

name: Kiserian to Corner Baridi Escarpment Crest
description: Climbs the windswept eastern rift shoulder to Corner Baridi ('Cold Corner'). Spectacular sweeping views west across the entire 50km floor of the Great Rift Valley.

name: Corner Baridi Escarpment Descent Hairpins
description: Legendary Safari Rally downhill stage. Hairpins plunging 400 vertical meters down the basalt fault escarpment, passing Olepolos country ridge.

name: Kisamis to Olchoro Onyore Valley
description: Rift valley floor transit through dry Acacia woodland and seasonal sandy river washes (luggas), skirting ancient basalt lava flows.
surface: Paved Road with Drift River Crossings

name: Olchoro Onyore to Tinga Centre
description: Long sweeping straights through undulating semi-arid pastoral savannah, flanked by distant rift fault scarps and cinder cones.

name: Tinga to Oloishoibor Plains
description: Arid flatlands with increasing ambient temperatures and red volcanic dust. High-speed gravel transit rally sectors.

name: Oloishoibor to Olorgesailie Prehistoric Site
description: Passes the world-famous Middle Pleistocene Acheulean handaxe archaeological site discovered by Mary & Louis Leakey. Exposed sedimentary lakebeds.

name: Olorgesailie to Kamukuru Sand Wash
description: Descent into extreme rift graben heat and thorny scrub. Road weaves between black volcanic lava outcrops and expansive sand washes.

name: Kamukuru to Lake Magadi Soda Flats & Causeway
description: Final dramatic descent to the lowest point of the southern Kenya Rift. Road terminates across the blinding white trona / soda ash causeway of Lake Magadi.
surface: Soda Salt Flat Causeway & Industrial Asphalt
